topic: Rahul Gandhi acquitted in Amit Shah defamation case
hook: Rahul Gandhi acquitted in *2018* Amit Shah defamation case
tldr: A Sultanpur MP-MLA court cleared Rahul Gandhi over a 2018 Bengaluru rally remark about Amit Shah.

beats.what: An MP-MLA court in Sultanpur, UP, acquitted Rahul Gandhi on Oct 26. He was in court.
beats.why: BJP's Vijay Mishra had complained in Aug 2018 over Gandhi's remark on then-BJP chief Amit Shah.
beats.care: Shows how long cases against politicians can drag: this one took over 8 years.

steps.e: Remark at a Bengaluru rally before Karnataka polls
Vijay Mishra files complaint in Sultanpur
Gandhi appears in court, gets bail

cards.t: In 2018, before the Karnataka Assembly polls, Rahul Gandhi made a remark about then-BJP president Amit Shah at a Bengaluru rally. Vijay Mishra, a Sultanpur BJP leader and ex-chairman of the District Cooperative Bank, filed a defamation complaint on Aug 4, 2018. Gandhi got bail in 2023. The verdict, first set for Oct 13, came on Oct 26: acquitted. The court's reasoning wasn't reported yet.

cards.q: Should defamation cases against politicians have a time limit?
Where was Rahul Gandhi's case heard?
cards.why: An MP-MLA court in Sultanpur. These special courts hear cases against MPs and MLAs.

learn.t: MP-MLA courts are special courts set up to speed up criminal cases against lawmakers.

watch: Whether the complainant appeals; the court's written reasons.
